how.label: lure the fly
how.text: Pecorino is deliberately made attractive to the cheese fly: it is lightly pressed, briefly brined and its rind pierced and oiled, so that Piophila casei lays its eggs inside. The larvae break down the paste, which turns soft to spreadably creamy with a strong, penetrating, piquant taste.
